scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-sync-protocol build && pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-local-sync build
scripts.test: pnpm test:runtime && pnpm --filter @agentwiki/server test && pnpm --filter @agentwiki/client test && pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-sync-protocol test && pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-local-sync test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agentwiki/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentwiki/client exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-sync-protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-local-sync typecheck
scripts.migrate:readable-sync-paths: pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-sync-protocol build && pnpm --filter @agentwiki/server build && node scripts/migrate-readable-sync-paths.mjs
scripts.migrate:space-folders:dry-run: pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-sync-protocol build && pnpm --filter @agentwiki/server build && node scripts/space-folder-migration.mjs --dry-run
scripts.migrate:space-folders:apply: pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-sync-protocol build && pnpm --filter @agentwiki/server build && node scripts/space-folder-migration.mjs --apply
scripts.test:e2e:markdown-db: node -e "if (!process.env.MARKDOWN_TEST_DATABASE_URL) { throw new Error('MARKDOWN_TEST_DATABASE_URL is required for the dedicated Markdown attachment gate'); }" && pnpm --filter @agentwiki/server build && MARKDOWN_ATTACHMENTS_DEDICATED_GATE=1 node --test scripts/markdown-attachments-schema-db.test.mjs scripts/markdown-attachments-http-db.test.mjs scripts/markdown-resource-resolution-db.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:folders-db: node -e "if (!process.env.FOLDER_TEST_DATABASE_URL) { throw new Error('FOLDER_TEST_DATABASE_URL is required for the dedicated Folder schema gate'); }" && pnpm --filter @neomei/agentwiki-sync-protocol build && pnpm --filter @agentwiki/server build && node --test scripts/folder-schema-db.test.mjs && node --test scripts/content-tree-core-db.test.mjs && node --test scripts/content-tree-operations-db.test.mjs && node --test scripts/content-tree-consumers-db.test.mjs && node --test scripts/space-folder-migration-db.test.mjs && node --test scripts/sync-v2-folder-db.test.mjs && node --test scripts/revision-retention-v2-db.test.mjs
